page.layout: One title page. Centred block of text at the top: a small line above a large title, then several smaller lines below. A printer's device (woodcut) in the middle of the page. Imprint at the bottom: place of printing, printer, year.
page.notes: The scan shows the title text mirrored and reversed, as if seen through the paper from the reverse side. Where the mirroring makes letters unreadable, they are marked as illegible rather than guessed. The title "SIXTI PAPAE" and "DECLARATIO" and the place "ROMÆ" are the most legible words. The printer's device in the middle of the page is a woodcut and is not transcribed. The date and the printer's name at the bottom could not be read with confidence. The small line above the title is too faint to read. Please check the page against the original book or a higher-resolution scan of the recto side.
